subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Should this PR be allowed to merge on scheduler tests plus the skipped internal-path Mantis manifest, or should it wait for visible live fallback proof from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97448 or an equivalent hook?
rationale: The code shape is focused and source-backed, but ClawSweeper cannot treat a skipped artifact with no baseline/candidate behavior as sufficient external-PR real behavior proof without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require Visible Proof Stack
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the proof stack or equivalent live hook shows main missing/blocking the generated media and the candidate delivering exactly one visible result.

options.title: Accept Internal Boundary Proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the scheduler matrix plus skipped Mantis manifest as enough for this hard-to-expose internal failure mode and own the remaining live uncertainty.

options.title: Re-scope Around Harness First
options.body: Wait for the proof-harness PR to land or close before deciding whether this production fallback PR still has the right merge boundary.

recommendation.title: Require Visible Proof Stack
recommendation.body: Keep this PR paused until the proof stack or equivalent live hook shows main missing/blocking the generated media and the candidate delivering exactly one visible result.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the original media completion recovery split and is the strongest history signal for whether scheduler-boundary proof is acceptable.
